# Dusk Fundgrove

> Dusk Fundgrove is an AI-assisted multi-asset trading platform for Bitcoin, Ethereum and 300+ markets, built for Australian investors. The platform runs an evening trading desk with AI signals, bank-grade custody and 24/7 human support.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://dusk-fundgrove-platform.com/): The evening desk. AI signals, custody and support for trading around the clock.
- [Product](https://dusk-fundgrove-platform.com/product): Charts, signals, portfolio tracking and an order workspace in one platform.
- [Features](https://dusk-fundgrove-platform.com/features): AI signals, copy trading, pro charting and 300+ markets in one account.
- [How It Works](https://dusk-fundgrove-platform.com/how-it-works): From sign up to first trade in one evening.
- [Reviews](https://dusk-fundgrove-platform.com/reviews): Letters from Australian investors, rated 4.9 out of 5.
- [About Us](https://dusk-fundgrove-platform.com/about-us): The story, values and principles behind Dusk Fundgrove.
- [Contact Us](https://dusk-fundgrove-platform.com/contact-us): Email support from real analysts, available 24/7.
- [FAQs](https://dusk-fundgrove-platform.com/faq): Answers about accounts, security, assets, deposits and withdrawals.
- [Sign Up](https://dusk-fundgrove-platform.com/sign-up): Create a free account in under two minutes.
